# Source notes

- [Profile README](https://github.com/BigBang1112/bigbang1112): short first-person introduction, compact project list, informal wording reserved for personal context.
- [GBX.NET README](https://github.com/BigBang1112/gbx-net): concrete opening description, domain and package names, extensive practical examples, explicit framework and compression caveats.
- [ManiaAPI.NET README](https://github.com/BigBang1112/maniaapi-net): named APIs and packages, step-by-step usage, direct reader address, and warnings about behaviors that can change data.
- [ManiaServerManager README](https://github.com/BigBang1112/mania-server-manager): clear statement of scope, explanation of the implementation, option lists, and candid operational limitations.
- [Minimal XmlReader README](https://github.com/BigBang1112/minimal-xmlreader): brief value proposition, measurable tradeoff, and prominent instability warning.
- [Markbang README](https://github.com/BigBang1112/markbang): project motivation, current versus planned features, and terse technical detail.
- [Compute Shadows Q&A](https://github.com/BigBang1112/compute-shadows/blob/master/Media/Translations/QnA/en.md): direct answers, practical workarounds, and openly stated uncertainty.
- [GBX.NET changelog](https://github.com/BigBang1112/gbx-net/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): compact change bullets naming the affected types and features.

These are patterns, not a fixed template. The repositories vary widely in age, size, and intended audience. Some Markdown is generated or inherited from forks, and the excluded repositories were deliberately ignored.
